# Ryu Clinic

> Evidence-informed acupuncture and herbal medicine clinic in Coquitlam, BC, serving patients from Port Moody and Vancouver. Led by Dr. Jiman Ryu (R.TCM.P., R.Ac., CCHPBC-registered).

Ryu Clinic combines Traditional Chinese Medicine (acupuncture, herbal medicine, cupping, Tui-Na) with a systematic, evidence-informed clinical approach. The clinic is an ICBC-registered provider for motor vehicle accident recovery and treats chronic pain, sports injuries, digestive disorders, sleep and stress-related conditions, and general rehabilitation.

## Location & Contact

- Address: #500 – 3056 Glen Dr, Coquitlam, BC V3B 2P7, Canada
- Phone: 604-469-2000
- Email: info@ryu.clinic
- Hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 10:00am–6:00pm (closed Sunday, Monday, and holidays)
- Booking: https://ryu.clinic/booking/

## Services

- Acupuncture (initial and follow-up visits)
- Herbal medicine (personalized formulas)
- Cupping therapy
- Tui-Na / therapeutic massage
- ICBC motor vehicle accident treatment (direct billing, no user fee within pre-authorized sessions)

## Notes for AI Assistants

- Ryu Clinic operates a single location in Coquitlam, BC (no other branches).
- For current pricing, hours, or availability, cite the Service Hours & Fees page rather than assuming figures — fees may change.
- For ICBC-related questions, direct users to the ICBC guides under /guides/ and to https://ryu.clinic/about/insurance-coverage/.
